'''Kerene Nagashi''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] and its [[Captain-General (Green Ajah)|Captain-General]]. She was also one of [[Tamra Ospenya's Searchers]].

==Appearance and Personality==
She was tall and beautiful with short dark hair lightly touched with white. Her eyes were nearly black. 

She was reputed to adhere to the strictest letter of the law no matter her own feelings, whether pity or contempt.{{ref/book|0|7}}

==Abilities and Strength==
Kerene was [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|exceptionally strong]] in the One Power, with a level of {{opsl|17}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kerene Nagashi|comp}} She stands above [[Moiraine Damodred]] and [[Siuan Sanche]], but lower than [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]]. Cadsuane said that "no one had come to the Tower who could match [herself] in a thousand years. No one to match Kerene or [[Meilyn Arganya|Meilyn]] in almost six hundred." There was "a sharp drop" between Kerene and Moiraine in terms of strength.{{ref/book|0|17}}  

==History==
Kerene was born in {{ne|793}}.{{ref||comp}} Her last name seems to indicate either [[Borderlands|Borderlander]] or [[Domani]] origin, although her nationality is never confirmed. 

We don't have details on her training and enrollment dates, but she likely was raised to the shawl around {{ne|820}}, making her a cohort of fellow Green sisters [[Adelorna Bastine]] and [[Merise Haindehl]] and [[Sitter|Sitters]] [[Saerin Asnobar]] and [[Suana Dragand]], among others.

She came from a home of rather modest character and had four siblings; two sisters and two brothers.

Kerene had two [[Warder]]s, [[Karile]] and [[Stepin]].

She was [[Captain-General (Green Ajah)|Captain-General]] of the Green Ajah.{{ref||comp}}

==Activities==
[[Tamra Ospenya]] personally hands [[Moiraine Damodred]] a letter to take to Kerene.{{ref/book|0|7}}

She had been Aes Sedai for well over 100 years when she was hand-picked to become one of [[Tamra Ospenya]]'s Searchers to find the [[Dragon Reborn]] after Tamra heard [[Gitara Moroso]]'s [[Foretelling]]. 

It was generally considered that she would be the next [[Amyrlin Seat]] after [[Sierin Vayu]], which infuriated Sierin and made Kerene nervous.{{ref||comp}}

===Death===
She reportedly fell off a ship in the [[River Alguenya]] during a storm and drowned. But in truth, she was killed by the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|0|18}}{{ref||comp}} She was around 185 years old at the time of her murder.

==In the television series==
* In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|TV series]], {{TVlink|Kerene Nagashi}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Clare Perkins}}.
